حُكْرَةٌ Collection and retention: this is the primary signification. (Er-Rághib.) ―
-b2- The withholding, (A, Mgh, Msb, K,) or collecting and withholding, (S,) wheat, (S, A, Mgh, Msb,) and the like, of what is eaten, (TA,) waiting for a time of dearness; (S, A, Mgh, Msb, K;) a subst. from اِحْتِكَارٌ; (Msb, K;) as also ↓ حَكَرٌ and ↓ حَكْرٌ . (Msb.) You say that the trade of such a one is الحُكْرَةُ. (A.) ―
-b3- Accord. to some, The selling
a thing without knowing its measure or weight. (TA.) ―
-b4- And A collection, or an aggregate. (TA.) ―
-b5- See also حَكَرٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
